name: ServerPolicy
description: Represents a policy specified for a document type stored on a server running Microsoft Office SharePoint Server.
remarks: The ServerPolicy object is composed of individual PolicyItem objects representing the individual policy definitions for the active document.
example:
Sub ListPolicyItems()
Dim objSrvPolicy As ServerPolicy
Dim objPolicyItem As PolicyItem
Dim strPolicyItemList As String

Set objSrvPolicy = ActiveDocument.ServerPolicy

For Each objPolicyItem In objSrvPolicy
 strPolicyItemList = "Policy Item " & objPolicyItem.Name & " - " & _
 objPolicyItem.Description & vbCrLf
Next
MsgBox (strPolicyItemList)

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ServerPolicy object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ServerPolicy object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a PolicyItem object from the ServerPolicy collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of a server policy. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the ServerPolicy object. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: A description of what the server policy is and its purpose. Read-only.

properties.name: Statement
properties.description: Gets the information specified in the policy statement. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the ServerPolicy collection. Read-only.

properties.name: BlockPreview
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that indicates whether you can preview items by using this policy. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ServerPolicy object. Read-only.
